items.headline: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.excerpt: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

items.headline: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
items.excerpt: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.

items.headline: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
items.excerpt: Richpanel uses GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol to equip its AI support agents with tools and procedures, and GPT-6 Luna for their conversations.

items.headline: Perplexity and Intelligence
items.excerpt: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.

items.headline: Combatting adversarial distillation
items.excerpt: OpenAI’s layered approach to adversarial distillation combines model training, safeguards, detection, and enforcement to protect against capability extraction.

items.headline: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
items.excerpt: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.

items.headline: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
items.excerpt: MedChemBench evaluates how well AI models interpret molecular structures, reason from experimental evidence, and select compounds in early drug discovery.

items.headline: How OpenAI’s Performance Factory keeps ChatGPT fast
items.excerpt: Learn how OpenAI built the Performance Factory, a system of Codex-powered workflows that finds and fixes performance issues to help keep ChatGPT fast.

items.headline: See PR scans in action
items.excerpt: Watch a walkthrough of PR scans and see how the presenter reviews scan results in a pull request workflow.

items.headline: Get started with Daybreak Blue
items.excerpt: Watch a walkthrough of onboarding to Daybreak Blue, with a closer look at the setup experience and how to get started.

items.headline: Explore the Codex Security Plugin
items.excerpt: Watch a demo of the Codex Security Plugin and see the workflow in action, from getting started to reviewing the results shown in the recording.

items.headline: Deploying Daybreak Red
items.excerpt: Explore a reference architecture for supervised security investigations with Daybreak Red, including safety controls, setup, and monitoring.

items.headline: The Silent Consensus
items.excerpt: Dean Ball, Head of Strategic Futures at OpenAI, examines how more capable AI could reshape society and how people can retain control of their institutions.

items.headline: Research acceleration: The jagged frontier
items.excerpt: OpenAI measures how coding agents are accelerating AI research, where their performance remains uneven, and what this signals about recursive self-improvement.

items.headline: How Sumitomo Life’s leaders helped teams adopt ChatGPT Enterprise
items.excerpt: Sumitomo Life uses ChatGPT Enterprise to research insurers, prepare proposals, and draft code for investment analysis. Early use by executives helped drive adoption.

items.headline: Inside the Codex sandbox
items.excerpt: See how Codex runs commands on your machine while enforcing the filesystem and network limits you control across macOS, Linux, and Windows.

items.headline: Managing frontier AI risk: From training to deployment
items.excerpt: OpenAI explains how it manages frontier AI risk from training through deployment with model alignment, sandboxing, blocking safeguards, and monitoring.

items.headline: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI partner to bring Le Figaro journalism to ChatGPT
items.excerpt: Le Groupe Figaro and OpenAI partner to bring Le Figaro’s journalism to ChatGPT through summaries and excerpts, with links to original stories.

items.headline: Advancing chip design with OpenAI models
items.excerpt: OpenAI models optimized circuits used in Jalapeño silicon and improved RISC‑V core designs, showing progress in AI-assisted chip design with GPT‑6 Astra.

items.headline: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
items.excerpt: Introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, with better professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.

items.headline: Strengthening NATO and allied cyber defenses with AI
items.excerpt: How OpenAI is working with NATO and allied cyber agencies to help trusted defenders find vulnerabilities, test fixes and protect essential systems.

items.headline: Introducing ChatGPT for Sales
items.excerpt: Explore the new Sales plugin and 30+ new and expanded partner plugins in ChatGPT to research prospects, prepare pitches, update your CRM, and move deals forward.

items.headline: Astra for Law leads in legal intelligence
items.excerpt: Astra for Law ranked first in a launch evaluation spanning 24 areas of law. Every ChatGPT Enterprise customer can now request access.

items.headline: Introducing OpenAI for Chile
items.excerpt: OpenAI and the Government of Chile are partnering to support responsible AI adoption, build public-sector skills and help local startups develop AI applications.
